instruction.name: xvreplve0.d
instruction.description: Repeat the first 64-bit lane from `a` to all lanes of `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplve0.d $xr0, $xr8; xvreplve0.d $xr1, $xr9; xvreplve0.d $xr2, $xr10; xvreplve0.d $xr3, $xr11; xvreplve0.d $xr4, $xr12; xvreplve0.d $xr5, $xr13; xvreplve0.d $xr6, $xr14; xvreplve0.d $xr7, $xr15
